label: Warm & Friendly
description: Soft earth tones, rounded corners, welcoming. Feels like a cosy shop you want to spend time in.
prompt: Warm and friendly — soft earth tones, rounded corners, generous spacing, inviting feel

label: Clean & Modern
description: Lots of white space, sharp lines, minimal. Professional without being cold.
prompt: Clean and modern — lots of white space, sharp geometric lines, minimal decoration, crisp and professional

label: Bold & Vibrant
description: Strong colours, large typography, energetic. Makes an immediate impression.
prompt: Bold and vibrant — strong saturated colours, large impactful typography, energetic layout with visual punch

label: Elegant & Refined
description: Muted palette, serif fonts, sophisticated. Feels premium and tasteful.
prompt: Elegant and refined — muted palette, serif headings, sophisticated spacing, premium feel with subtle details

label: Fun & Playful
description: Bright colours, friendly shapes, casual. Cheerful and approachable.
prompt: Fun and playful — bright cheerful colours, rounded friendly shapes, casual tone, playful layout with personality

label: You Decide!
description: Let AI analyse your content and pick the best style. You can always steer it afterwards.
prompt: Analyse the uploaded content — the type of business, the tone of the text, the style of the images — and choose the most appropriate design direction. Explain your choice.
